Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
release: v0.6.0 — security hardening, bug fixes, and professional OSS governance

Security:
- Add subprocess timeouts \(120s\) to all git operations to prevent DoS
- Add Content-Length limit \(1MB\) on HTTP request bodies
- Strengthen path traversal protection with fully-resolved containment checks
- Add Content-Security-Policy and crossorigin attributes to web UI
- Replace bare `except Exception` with specific exception types throughout

Bug fixes:
- Suppress CLI banner when stdout is piped to prevent JSON corruption
- Fix tkinter root window leak with proper finally cleanup
- Add thread-safe locking to SSE listener list
- Guard Content-Length parsing against malformed header values
- Add upper bound \(100MB\) to max_file_size_bytes configuration
- Fix Node.js stderr collection using Buffer.concat

Organization:
- Add SECURITY.md with vulnerability disclosure policy
- Add .github/CODEOWNERS for automatic review assignment
- Add PEP 561 py.typed marker for typed package compliance
- Expand .gitignore with secrets, IDE, and OS patterns
- Translate Portuguese log messages to English

Testing:
- Add 72 new tests covering reporting, commands, server, analyzers, and CLI
- Coverage increased from 85% to 90% \(235 tests passing\)

Version bumped from 0.6.0b0 to 0.6.0 across Python and Node packages.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(web-ui\): remove CSP meta tag that blocked Tailwind CSS rendering

The Content-Security-Policy header prevented the Tailwind CDN from
dynamically generating and injecting styles, leaving the web UI
completely unstyled. Since the server is local-only, the CSP provided
minimal security benefit while breaking core functionality.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(web-ui\): remove crossorigin attributes blocking Tailwind CDN

The crossorigin="anonymous" attribute on the Tailwind CDN script tag
caused the browser to enforce CORS checks that the CDN does not
satisfy, preventing the script from loading entirely and leaving the
UI completely unstyled.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
